items.label: Stadium Approved Size
items.value: Perfect size for stadium events - 6.5" H x 8.27" L x 3.27" W, meets the clear bag policy of no larger than 12*12*6 inches, making it approved by stadiums,concerts, and sports events.

items.label: Waterproof PVC Material
items.value: The clear bag purse is made of 0.4mm thick pvc, which is resistant to deformation or breakage; the excellent waterproof performance ensures that all your belongings will always stay dry. Note:Keep it out of water or heavy rain.

items.label: Time-saving and Convenient
items.value: The clear crossbay bag allows complete visibility all around.Pass through security with the see-through bag to avoid being turned away at security checkpoints, and it's convenient to double-check that you have everything you need before leaving.

items.label: Suitable Capacity
items.value: This messenger bag has a main compartment can hold a small wallet, phone, lipstick, tissues, and sunglasses, while the front pocket can hold keys, cash, cards, and tickets, making our clear bag an essential for your concert outfit.

items.label: Multiple Ways to Carry
items.value: The removable shoulder strap is made of quality nylon which makes it more durable. The shoulder strap can be adjusted to 51 inches for different styles,such as a crossbody bag or a shoulder bag, making it suitable for women.
